title: Non-pointed low-rank ribbon rows remain blocked after pointed-row progress
top_notice: After resolving the pointed Z4 and Z2xZ2 rows, the catalog has 8 resolved rows and 6 blocked non-pointed rows. The remaining rows cannot be safely materialized from current repo data: the SU(2)_2 local R/F backend is only a fixed all-sigma braid-closure backend, not a full Ising RibbonFusionCategoryV2 realization. Formal scan-plan generation and controls remain blocked.
validated_behaviors: The foundation validator now permits ribbon realization counts greater than braided class counts only when explicit ribbon multiplicity metadata is present.
The foundation validator rejects duplicate snapshot hashes in a resolved family row.
The v10 catalog keeps rank3-ising, rank3-psu2-5, rank4-psu2-7, rank5-su2-4, rank5-psu2-9, and rank5-psu3-4 blocked.

The rank3 Ising blocker records that experiments/results/local-piece/su2-2-rf-local-backend-v1.json is unsafe as a full category realization because its scope is fixed-label all-sigma braid closures and its not_scope includes mixed simple labels.
The PSU/SU rows record missing q6j/F/R/source/gauge certificates rather than guessing realizations.
The v10 readiness artifact states step 6 scan-plan generation is not started and blocked by the partial catalog, and step 7 controls are not started because no formal scan plan exists.
